occurrences.text: And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine.
But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us.
But Paul said, I am a man which am a Jew of Tarsus, a city in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and, I beseech thee, suffer me to speak unto the people.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
